Nature’s collagen alternative ~ no refined sugar  I make these at @rawlalajuice check my stories Thursdays when I restock Snow Fungus, Asian Pear, Peach Gum, Red Jujube Date, Job’s Tears, Lily Bulb, Goji berry, Chrysanthemum, Honey  Recipe:  Makes 5 cups 1 litre water 1 handful peach gum 1 small handful snow fungus (about 10g) 2 tbsp Job’s tears 3 tbsp dried lily bulb 1 handful red dates 1 handful dried longan 2 Korean or Asian pears 1 small handful chrysanthemum flowers 1 handful goji berries Agave or Manila honey, to taste Pinch of sea salt Method:  NIGHT BEFORE Soak peach gum and Job’s tears in a big bowl of cold water. Peach gum swells 10x so go bigger than you think. Fridge, overnight. ON THE DAY 	1.	Drain the peach gum. Pick out any dark bark or grit. Rinse. 	2.	Soak lily bulb in cold water, fridge, 1 ~ 2 hours. 	3.	🔺Soak snow fungus cold water 30 ~ 1 hour NEVER leave in room temperature to soak overnight (can be dangerous!)  	4.	Cut the hard yellow core off the fungus. Tear the frills small. 	5.	Peel, core and quarter the pears. 	6.	Pot: peach gum, Job’s tears, snow fungus, pear, red dates, longan. Cover with water. 	7.	Boil, then lowest simmer, lid on, 1 hour. Stir every 20 mins so the Job’s tears don’t catch. 	8.	Add lily bulb. Chrysanthemum in a tea strainer. Simmer 8 mins, then lift the flowers out. 	9.	Off the heat: salt, goji, Manuka honey. Taste. More honey if you want. 	10.	Warm or chilled. It sets thicker overnight

Where does collagen go after you drink it? Collagen supplements don't travel intact from your stomach straight to your skin or joints. Your digestive system breaks collagen down into smaller components, including amino acids and peptides, which are then absorbed and used by the body. Collagen is particularly rich in amino acids such as glycine and proline, which are among the building blocks involved in protein and collagen production. Vitamin C also plays an important role in normal collagen formation. Research has also explored whether certain collagen peptides may have signaling effects, so the story isn't simply “collagen gets destroyed.” The bigger takeaway? You're supplying raw materials, not shipping finished collagen directly to your skin. 💬 What benefit are you hoping to get from collagen? #collagen #collagenpeptides #collagenpowder #vitaminc #glycine #proline #protein #aminoacids #skinhealth #jointhealth #supplements #nutritiontok
